title: Q-CLAIM-COVER-site-stakeholders-js: unbound claim-like statements on site/stakeholders.js
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** claims coverage, every PR and daily
**Done check:** grep:doctrine/claims.json::"surface": "site/stakeholders.js"
**Status:** open

COVERAGE-1: 4 claim-like lines (first 233) on `site/stakeholders.js` state a number, cadence or guarantee with no registered claim and probe.

Bind each to a probe in `doctrine/claims.json` (or generate the sentence from code), or change the words to what the code does.

size: S
